name: GameBench
description: GameBench is a cross-domain benchmark designed to evaluate the strategic reasoning abilities of large language model agents across nine different game environments. It assesses key reasoning skills in strategy games and compares model performance with human levels using various prompting techniques.
reputation: A recent research benchmark with modest adoption, used mainly to probe LLM strategic reasoning in game-playing settings.
notes: Focuses on strategic reasoning in games; uses GPT-3 and GPT-4 with Chain-of-Thought and Reasoning Via Planning prompting.
